drives.title: Put the map from before back on the car
drives.body: Stop open: flash your previous map file, and tell me which one it is. In KTuner: load the file you ran before this Drive and flash it. I have no Map version before the one this Drive ran on — tell me what you flashed and I can name the file to flash back. Save today's file first so nothing is lost. Then drive a Shakedown drive: 10 calm minutes, no hard driving.

drives.body: Every “did it work?” needs a Drive to compare against. Heat moves boost, timing and the 50→70 time on its own, so the Baseline has to be a Cool Drive.
drives.also: Knock Control went 0.49 → 0.65: about 1.6° of timing taken under boost. Not damage. 31 of its 41 step-ups came while the CVT held 1,509 rpm with load in 53 °C air.
